independent_semantic_review.scope: Public/private RNG boundary, candidate ownership, frozen protocol, completed artifact bindings and intervention provenance

limits: Three selected outcome-discordant development fights, not a new win-rate sample or an Act 1 claim.
Fixed-seed one-action causal contrasts apply to the specified continuation policy; they do not establish a globally optimal action.
Public sampled-world returns follow greedy continuation; tree Q values describe searched/bootstrapped continuation and have a different target.
The 768 arm records share 544 distinct sampled action continuations; repeated arm recommendations are not additional observations.
Samples come from the existing approximate public belief, not a certified exact posterior or the true hidden state.
No changed default, learned update, new holdout evaluation, PPO behavior claim, or bridge demonstration.
next_experiment: Test bounded policy rollouts for leaf evaluation on development data at a fixed total time budget; retain frozen greedy, root-only and current Gumbel controls, then run a fresh frozen paired confirmation.

protocol.interpretation: Post-hoc causal/critic diagnosis on selected development examples; no new win-rate estimate, promotion or held-out evidence.

public_continuations.pairing: Identical sampled-world seeds per first action, identical recommendations share a rollout. No actual game state or RNG is read.

real_interventions.boundary: Only the evaluator reads its private replay seed; policies receive public declarations/observations. Diagnostic interventions are not search targets or training data.
real_interventions.controls: Replay each original Gumbel fight and assert public trajectory equality.
real_interventions.diagnostic: At each position also compare recorded Gumbel vs actor first action followed by greedy continuation in the same original actual world.
real_interventions.variants: At each of the eight selected positions, replace exactly the recorded Gumbel action with the actor action, keep the prefix identical, then resume unchanged Gumbel search.

protocol.selection: All three Gumbel/greedy outcome-discordant development cases; all eight non-duplicate semantic disagreements with the actor along their Gumbel public trajectories.
